title: Build Standalone Game
iconError: Please select an image file (PNG recommended, 256×256 or larger).

webBuild.name: Web Build
webBuild.desc: Play in browser • itch.io ready • No saves persist
webBuild.intro: This creates a browser-based game that you can:
webBuild.item2: ✅ Share on any web host (Netlify, GitHub Pages, etc.)
webBuild.item3: ✅ Send to friends as a ZIP file

desktopBuild.name: Desktop Build
desktopBuild.intro: This creates a standalone desktop app with:
desktopBuild.item4: 🖥️ Works on Windows, Mac, and Linux
desktopBuild.installerWarning: ⚡ Installer builds are faster to build and launch instantly after install — the setup extracts all files ahead of time
desktopBuild.standaloneWarning: ⏱ Standalone builds take longer to build and are slower to start — the exe must unpack itself into a temp folder on every launch

noCodingRequired: No coding required! Just download and distribute.

formatPicker.title: Build Format
formatPicker.standaloneDesc: Single portable executable — no installation needed, just run
formatPicker.standaloneNote: ⏱ Slower build & startup — exe must unpack on every launch
formatPicker.installerDesc: Setup wizard with shortcuts, install directory, uninstaller, and game saves folder
formatPicker.installerNote: ⚡ Faster build & startup — files are pre-extracted during install

helpBox.before: After building, you'll get a ZIP file. Upload it to
helpBox.after: and you're done! No command line needed.

desktop.working: Desktop builds take a few minutes — the app is working in the background.

android.working: This can take several minutes the first time — please keep Flourish open.

success.webText: Your game is ready to share on the web!
success.installerText: Your installer with shortcuts and game saves directory is ready!
success.desktopText: Your standalone desktop game is ready!

web.step1Upload: Upload the ZIP file you just downloaded
web.step1Check: Check "This file will be played in the browser"
web.step2Desc: Unzip and upload the contents to any web host
web.step3Desc: Send the ZIP to friends - they can unzip and open index.html

desktop.step1Installer: Run the Setup installer to install your game
desktop.step1Standalone: Double-click the executable to test your game
desktop.step2InstallerDesc: The installer will create desktop/start menu shortcuts, an install directory, and a game saves folder
desktop.step2StandaloneDesc: They just download and run - no installation needed
desktop.step3Item2: • Players' progress is saved to their computer
desktop.step3Item3: • Works offline with no server needed
desktop.step4Item4: • Game saves stored in user data folder
desktop.step5Platform: Build on Windows for .exe, Mac for .app, Linux for .AppImage

android.step1Desc: Copy the .apk to your Android device (USB cable, a cloud drive, or email).
android.step2Desc: When you tap the file, Android may ask permission to install from this source — allow it.
android.step3Desc: Tap the .apk to install, then open your game.
android.note: More automated publishing options are coming in a future update.

error.title: Build Failed
error.fix1: Make sure your project has at least one scene
error.fix2: Check that all assets are properly loaded
error.fix3: Try closing and reopening the app

androidBuild.name: Android
androidBuild.desc: Installable app for Android phones & tablets (.apk)
androidBuild.intro: Packages your game as a native Android app that installs and runs on phones and tablets — taps instead of clicks, with saves stored on the device just like the desktop build.
androidBuild.item2: Saves & progress are kept on the device (no browser size limits)
androidBuild.item4: Share the .apk file directly with players
androidBuild.publishingLater: More automated publishing options are coming in a future update.
androidBuild.desktopOnly: Android builds are only available in the desktop version of Flourish.

androidConfig.title: App details
androidConfig.packageInvalid: Use a unique id like com.yourname.game (lowercase letters and dots)

androidGate.title: One-time Android setup
androidGate.body: Building for Android needs the Android toolchain (Java, the Android SDK and Gradle). Flourish sets this up for you automatically — but it is a one-time download of about {{size}} GB (about {{disk}} GB once unpacked).
androidGate.installerLite: We download it now instead of bundling it so Flourish’s installer stays small and fast.
androidGate.oneTime: You only do this once. Every Android build after this works offline.
